versions.changelog:
- Added a new "Start on APIDot" section in SKILL.md to highlight main APIDot entry points.
- No longer includes the file skill-card.md; that file has been removed.
- Minor editorial changes in SKILL.md for clarity and flow.
- No changes to core functionality; the skill remains documentation-only.

Initial release for APIDot GPT 5.5 API skill.

- Provides documentation for APIDot’s GPT 5.5 API, including model routing, integration guidance, and usage tracking.
- Offers comprehensive security rules and API key handling instructions (documentation-only; no executable code or network calls).
- Includes official APIDot links for model pages, docs, quickstart, examples, and support.
- Contains both an overview (`SKILL.md`) and local notes (`references/api.md`), but no bundled clients or automated helpers.
- Meant for users building with GPT 5.5 on APIDot, focusing on chat, agents, complex coding, document analysis, and agentic workflows.
